source.name: SportsPro - Serie A scores '€22m per year' Enilive title sponsorship
source.quote: Company will reportedly pay €22 million (US$23.6 million) per year in deal that includes option of a further two seasons beyond 2026/27

note: Competition naming-rights deal. Value: SportsPro (2024-02-06) reports €22m per year, reportedly, with an option of two further seasons beyond 2026/27. Term: Eni's own release (2024-02-05, https://www.eni.com/en-IT/media/press-release/2024/02/enilive-becomes-serie-a-title-sponsor.html) titles the agreement 'up until 2027' and says it covers three seasons from 2024/25, so the confirmed term runs to 2026-27; the option years are not part of it.
